title: Verification cost: re-preview only touched shards, one-line survivor annotations, one controller session per story without 1 s polling, emit done.cost

outcomes.statement: The tenant verification-cost contract is delivered and reaches every agent harness: WORK_READINESS.md scopes a fix-round re-preview to the shards whose sources intersect the files changed since the previous preview (a whole-set re-preview needs a named closure reason), defines a survivor annotation as one line (mutant id, file:line, @equivalent or @accepted, reason) with no separate signed report or counterfactual log, adds a Session shape section (one controller session per story opened at readiness and closed at done, reviewer-briefed adversarial AC verification and scoped review, blocking waits or yields of 60 s or more), and adds a closure template that requires done.cost with a measured-or-estimated notes sentence; docs/dev-guide/local/CLAUDE.md carries the short form, and AGENTS.md links it so a Codex session sees it.
outcomes.demo: Read WORK_READINESS.md §Per-task mutation previews, §Session shape and §Closure template, docs/dev-guide/local/CLAUDE.md §Verification cost, and the AGENTS.md link line; run pnpm check:generated-guidance and verify it exits 0.

outcomes.statement: Completion actuals may carry optional non-negative integer preview_rounds and preview_minutes next to mutation_minutes, in both work-readiness.schema.json and the gate's validateCompletionActuals; a non-integer or negative value is rejected and artifacts without them stay valid.
outcomes.demo: pnpm test:work-readiness: an actuals object with preview_rounds 2 and preview_minutes 25 validates; one with preview_minutes "25" or -1 fails WR_SCHEMA_INVALID-class; CHG-062's actuals (no preview keys) still validate.

outcomes.statement: check:generated-guidance is green again: one registered CHG-065 overlay layer binds the five guidance files drifted by the 2026-10-01 Nous sync (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md, TESTING.md, testing/critical-paths.md) from their latest pinned bytes to the delivered bytes, AGENTS.md's negative tenant-column phrase is an approved negative phrase, the reviewed reconciler digest is re-pinned, and the AGENTS.md link commit is owned by the layer registered in its parent tree.
outcomes.demo: pnpm check:generated-guidance exits 0; python3 -m unittest infra/scripts/tests/test_reconcile_sprint1_docs.py passes; node scripts/work-readiness.mjs check-range main HEAD passes.

uncertainties.statement: validateCompletionActuals' closed actuals key set lives in scripts/work-readiness/model.mjs (validateActualsShape, lines 181-198), a file the parallel CHG-066 session owns.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco ruled (2026-10-03 operator session): every other item lands first; after CHG-066 merges and chg-065 is rebased onto it, one small commit adds preview_rounds and preview_minutes to the optional list with two integer() checks, the schema properties and the gate test. This approval covers that model.mjs edit. Falsifier: CHG-066 does not merge, in which case the commit waits rather than editing model.mjs concurrently.

uncertainties.statement: check:generated-guidance was already red on main before CHG-065 (five guidance files in states no layer registers since the 2026-10-01 Nous sync, and AGENTS.md's 'not `tenant_id`' phrase tripping the forbidden-token rule), so an AGENTS.md link cannot be registered without re-pinning all five.
uncertainties.resolution: Francisco chose the full re-pin inside CHG-065 over a follow-up CHG. One CHG-065 layer binds each file from its latest pinned desired bytes (AGENTS.md and critical-paths.md: CHG-049/6466f60; CLAUDE.md: CHG-053/2dee869; DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md: CHG-055/e240d85; TESTING.md: CHG-059/7f42371) to the delivered bytes, with AGENTS.md's desired bytes also carrying the link line. The build_plan layer chain was read: a current hash equal to a layer's desired hash is accepted, and later layers chain by source hash.

uncertainties.statement: exactOverlayOwns reads the reconciler at the commit's parent, so a single commit that registers the layer and edits AGENTS.md is not owned.
uncertainties.resolution: Two commits: the layer registration (reconciler, manifest, desired bytes, REVIEWED_RECONCILER_SHA256 re-pin in git.mjs, reconciler test) first, then the AGENTS.md link. node scripts/work-readiness.mjs check-range main HEAD is run after each.

uncertainties.statement: Rebasing onto CHG-066 can conflict in .nous-feedback.jsonl and scripts/test-work-readiness.mjs.
uncertainties.resolution: Feedback conflicts keep both sides' lines in ts order and pnpm test:feedback-order must pass; new gate tests sit in one self-contained block at the end of test-work-readiness.mjs. Budgeted in integration.

uncertainties.statement: The CHG body names 'pnpm lint (check:generated-guidance)', but check:generated-guidance is not part of pnpm lint (root lint is turbo run lint).
uncertainties.resolution: Both are verified separately: pnpm lint and pnpm check:generated-guidance must each exit 0.

uncertainties.statement: The measured acceptance targets (preview_minutes <= 30, focused_verification <= 35 %, single-line survivors, [Execution Cost] coverage, polling <= 10 %) are observed on the next parent's children, not inside CHG-065.
uncertainties.resolution: CHG-065 closes on the validation it can run now (test:work-readiness, lint, check:generated-guidance, readiness:check CHG-065, one pnpm check) and on practising the contract itself; the measured targets are Nous's to read later with story timeline and actuals.

actuals.root_cause: Wall-clock from the CHG-065 ledger, rounded up per bucket; the ~22 h blocked on CHG-066 (2026-10-03 15:16Z to 2026-10-04 ~13:25Z, per Francisco's ruling to sequence the model.mjs edit after CHG-066) is excluded as idle. readiness = session start 14:46Z to started 15:04Z (18), including the scope rulings on model.mjs and the full guidance re-pin. implementation = started to the focused_verification marker (8) plus Task 4 on 2026-10-04 (5). focused_verification = marker to the first reviewer's verdicts (4) plus the one preflight (1, 0 shards). review = the review marker to closure (4); the first reviewer's six findings were fixed in one loop. integration = the rebase onto CHG-066/067, the ledger-order conflict and Francisco's append ruling, and closure (20). The estimate's 90-minute impact for the guidance re-pin (U2) was mostly not needed: the layer chain took one manifest plus fixture-stamp fixes. pnpm check exit 0 replayed every workspace task from the turbo cache (no workspace inputs changed); the root checks CHG-065 changes (test:work-readiness 282, reconciler unittest 59, check:generated-guidance, readiness:check:all 53) were run directly and passed. No whole-set re-preview: zero shards, no previews, no cold campaign, no test_report.
